method: Each claim checked against the retrieved abstract text of its cited source, not the citation.

claims.claim: Scope: postmenopausal women and men aged 50 and over
claims.source_text: the assessment and management of osteoporosis and the prevention of fragility fractures in postmenopausal women and men aged 50 years and older

claims.claim: S1 covers diagnosis, fracture-risk assessment and intervention thresholds, vertebral fractures, non-pharmacological and pharmacological treatment, duration and monitoring of anti-resorptive therapy, GIOP, models of care
claims.source_text: Review of the evidence and recommendations are provided for the diagnosis of osteoporosis, fracture-risk assessment and intervention thresholds, management of vertebral fractures, non-pharmacological and pharmacological treatments, including duration and monitoring of anti-resorptive therapy, glucocorticoid-induced osteoporosis, as well as models of care for fracture prevention

claims.claim: S1 recommendations systematically graded by strength of evidence
claims.source_text: Conclusions and recommendations have been systematically graded according to the strength of the available evidence

claims.claim: GIOP scope: >3 months of glucocorticoids at >=2.5 mg daily
claims.source_text: for patients with rheumatic or nonrheumatic conditions receiving >3 months treatment with glucocorticoids (GCs) >=2.5 mg daily

claims.claim: Assess as soon as possible after GC initiation: clinical fracture assessment, BMD with vertebral fracture assessment or spinal x-ray, FRAX if >=40; strong
claims.source_text: we strongly recommend as soon as possible after initiation of GCs, initial assessment of fracture risks with clinical fracture assessment, bone mineral density with vertebral fracture assessment or spinal x-ray, and Fracture Risk Assessment Tool if >=40 years old

claims.claim: Pharmacological treatment strongly recommended at medium, high or very high fracture risk
claims.source_text: For adults at medium, high, or very high fracture risk, we strongly recommend pharmacologic treatment

claims.claim: Choice among oral/IV bisphosphonates, denosumab, PTH analogues by shared decision-making
claims.source_text: Choice of oral or intravenous bisphosphonates, denosumab, or parathyroid hormone analogs should be made by shared decision-making

claims.claim: Anabolic agents CONDITIONALLY recommended as initial therapy in high and very high fracture risk
claims.source_text: Anabolic agents are conditionally recommended as initial therapy for those with high and very high fracture risk

claims.claim: S2 used GRADE with >=70% voting panel consensus
claims.source_text: Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development and Evaluation approach was used to rate the certainty of evidence. A Voting Panel achieved >=70% consensus

claims.claim: PBS: no osteoporosis agent unrestricted; romosozumab authority; colecalciferol not listed
claims.source_text: Schedule 4333 items query: Alendronate 14 rows ['A','R','S']; Risedronate 25 rows ['A','R']; Zoledronic 24 rows ['S']; Denosumab 14 rows ['S']; Teriparatide 6 rows ['S']; Romosozumab 2 rows ['A']; Raloxifene 8 rows ['S']; Colecalciferol no rows
